steps.line: Kristopher sits in his car in the lot behind the hotel, the five-dollar bill with Violet's number on the dash. He dials her number again.
Kristopher hears the ring stop and someone breathing on the other end. "Hello? Violet? It's Kristopher. Sorry, I know I just called."
He takes a breath. "I forgot to ask what time tomorrow."
Kristopher waits, the phone warm against his ear. "Would four work? At the coffee shop on Broadway?"
He laughs at himself. "Or any time. Tomorrow works, right?"
"Okay. Four. I'll see you there, Violet." Kristopher hangs up and sets the phone face-down on the passenger seat.
